defects.problem: Yellow highlight on ShowMe starts partially drawn and covers only the S and h at first, looks like a glitch
defects.fix: Start the highlight fully drawn or wipe from the left edge cleanly

defects.problem: Static end card with a tiny caption; URL and GitHub lines have equal weight so the call to action is diluted
defects.fix: Make the URL bigger than the GitHub line

defects.problem: Caption pinned bottom-left far from the centred content, with AI-generated narration label tiny

oneLineVerdict: Clean, legible and stable but plain; the highlight start and diluted CTA hold it back.
